newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish deputy treasury minister dismissed - official.
newsitem.headline: Polish deputy treasury minister dismissed - official.

text.p: Polish Prime Minister Wlodzimierz Cimoszewicz has dismissed deputy treasury minister Leszek Juchniewicz, the ministry's official responsible for large-scale privatisations, the government press office said.
A press office statement, issued late on Friday, did not give a reason for the dismissal and offered no further details.

Juchniewicz has been overseeing the controversial privatisation of Poland's largest newsstand chain Ruch SA, in which a bid from a Polish-French consortium led by France's Hachette Distribution Services has been challenged with a late offer by a Polish group.
In December 1996 the ministry signed an initial agreement with Hachette on Ruch sale but later Juchniewicz said the ministry would consider another bid if it proved competitive.

Gazeta Wyborcza daily suggested on Saturday the dismissal might have been linked to the Ruch deal, although it quoted Juchniewicz's secretary as saying the minister had already handed in his resignation in January, before the latest controversy.
It said Juchniewicz himself would not comment on the move. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
